environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering is configured on the ALB. The service is accessed directly via the ALB DNS name.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule on HTTPS:443
